pr.title: docs(fast-dev-os): install packet+proof templates (final doctrine packet)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Installs 5 root-level template files at `docs/03-reference/fast-dev-os/` and 2 files in a new `templates-proof/` subdirectory.
- These templates are the schema-of-record for all subsequent Fast Dev OS packets.
- Closes the Phase 0–2 doctrine layer (TP-DMX-FDOS-004 + 005 + 006).

## Scope
Docs only. 12-path allowlist. No runtime / service / test / compose / dependency changes.

## Boundary discipline
- `task-packet-template.json` validates against `dopetask-canonical-spec.json` (the template is itself schema-valid).
- `proof-bundle-template.json` contains every AGENTS.md §9 required field as a top-level key.
- `template-pr-body.md` includes a Forbidden Phrases section enforcing the truth-posture statement.
- `runtime-dependency-cones.md` declares cross-workstream collision constraints.
- `validation-command-library.md` consolidates the reusable validation snippets used across all Fast Dev OS packets.

## Templates subdirectory naming
The plan originally called for a `proof/` subdirectory under `fast-dev-os/`. To avoid name-collision confusion with the repo-root `proof/` directory (which holds actual PROOF.json files), this packet uses `templates-proof/` instead. Documented in `templates-proof/readme.md`.

## Task Packet
- ID: `TP-DMX-FDOS-006-PACKET-PROOF-TEMPLATES`
- Path: `task-packets/generated/TP-DMX-FDOS-006-PACKET-PROOF-TEMPLATES.json`
- Series: `DMX-FDOS` (parent: `TP-DMX-FDOS-005-EXECUTOR-PROMPT-PACK`; **final_packet: true**)
- Schema: validates against `docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json` (PASS)
- Allowlist: 12 paths

## Proof
- Bundle: `proof/fast-dev-os/TP-DMX-FDOS-006-PACKET-PROOF-TEMPLATES/PROOF.json`
- All AGENTS.md §9 required fields populated.

## Stacked PR note
This branch is stacked on `codex/dmx-fdos-005-executor-prompt-pack` (PR #676, OPEN). The diff vs main temporarily includes TP-FDOS-004 + 005 + 006 (~46 files cumulative); after PRs #675 and #676 merge, this PR's diff narrows to only the 12 paths added by TP-FDOS-006.

## Validation (exit code 0 unless noted)
- jsonschema TP — PASS
- jsonschema task-packet-template.json against same spec — PASS (the template is itself schema-valid; strongest single check for this packet)
- json.tool TP + PROOF + task-packet-template.json + proof-bundle-template.json — PASS
- docs_validator + docs_frontmatter_guard (5 markdown files) — PASS
- docs-filename-hygiene (5 files) — OK
- grep 'Forbidden phrases' in template-pr-body.md — present
- grep AGENTS.md in 4 markdown templates — present
- git diff --check / --cached --check — clean
- pal/codereview (gpt-5.2-pro, internal) — see PROOF.json
- pal/precommit (gpt-5.2-pro, internal) — see PROOF.json

## NOT_RUN
- Live provider calls
- Live extraction
- Docker startup
- Runtime service health checks
- Generator script to materialize templates into new packets (deferred to a future TP)
- CI enforcement of template-pr-body.md sections (deferred to TP-DMX-FDOS-007-GITHUB-GATES, out of current plan scope)

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- RISK-TEMPLATE-DRIFT: templates go stale as dopetask-canonical-spec.json evolves; refresh policy is manual-per-schema-change.
- RISK-PROOF-NORMALIZATION: existing PROOF.json files in proof/**/ use heterogeneous shapes (per `proof-ledger.md`); this template defines the new canonical shape but does NOT retroactively normalize existing files (out of scope).
- RISK-PR-BODY-ENFORCEMENT: template-pr-body.md is advisory until TP-FDOS-007 lands (CI hook to enforce required sections).
